notes.title: Update 8.1.1
notes.content:
- Re-added the Multi-Buy button max option to all placements. Use the shortcut key 'Alt' to trigger it directly
- You are now able to change your Multi-Pack multipliers when you haven't opened any slot
- Fixed handling of very large lore packs in client
- Some minor tweaks like quest texts for open blueprint pack quest

notes.title: Update 8.1
notes.content:
- New Dynasty Tab: Additional Stats and Details about your perma buffs
- Improved perma buffs: Lore per fame and blueprint space upgrades changed from absolute to multiplicative
- Multi Blueprint Pack mode: Use multiple tokens to open slots with multiple blueprint rewards
- Multi buy button improvement: Replaced the max button with a text input for some placements
- Polish: Performance improved. We keep working on improving your experience!

notes.title: Update 8.0: Artifact Challenge
notes.content:
- New Feature: The Artifact Challenge
- Create and collect legendary artifacts with permanent buffs
- Added daily and weekly quests 
- Craft and trade the new artifact shards
- Join with other players to overcome obstacles
- General interface scaling changes for long term sustainability
- Polish: Performance improved. We keep working on improving your experience!
